assertion: US crude oil production has hit a record 14.3 million barrels per day (bopd), according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).
inaccuracy: The claim says production has hit 14.3 mb/d; EIA says 14.3 is the forecast for calendar 2027 and the 2026 record is 13.9. Warehouse peak monthly output is 13.995 mb/d (Oct 2025).
warehouse_value: max monthly NUS 13,995 kb/d (Oct 2025); 2026 Jan-Aug avg 13,789 kb/d
independent_value: EIA STEO Nov 2026: 14.3 mb/d forecast for 2027; 13.9 in 2026
sql: SELECT production_year, production_month, production_volume FROM energy.eia_crude_oil_production WHERE eia_area_code='NUS' AND production_unit='MBBL/D' ORDER BY production_volume DESC
